scripts.script:
-- ==============================================================================
-- SCRIPT MODO PC + TECLADO DE CHAT (COMPATIBLE CON DELTA)
-- ==============================================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Limpiar interfaz anterior si existe
if playerGui:FindFirstChild("TotalPCMode_Ultimate") then
    playerGui.TotalPCMode_Ultimate:Destroy()
end

-- Ocultar controles táctiles originales de Roblox
pcall(function()
    local touchGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    if touchGui then touchGui.Enabled = false end
end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child.Name == "TouchGui" then child.Enabled = false end
end)

local function getHumanoid()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TotalPCMode_Ultimate"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
ScreenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainControlsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainControlsFrame.Name = "MainControlsFrame"
mainControlsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
mainControlsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainControlsFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local function makeButton(name, text, size, pos, parent, color)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    corner.Parent = btn

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    stroke.Parent = btn

    btn.Parent = parent or mainControlsFrame
    return btn
end

local function simulateKey(keyCode)
    if VirtualInputManager then
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
        end)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CÁMARA Y DISPARO TÁCTIL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local camZone = Instance.new("TextButton")
camZone.Name = "MouseTouchpad"
camZone.Text = ""
camZone.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0.75, 0)
camZone.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.05, 0)
camZone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
camZone.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local draggingCam = false
local lastPos = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local sensitivity = 0.007

camZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        draggingCam = true
        lastPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    end
end)

camZone.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingCam and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local currentPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local delta = currentPos - lastPos
        lastPos = currentPos
        
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local xAngle = -delta.X * sensitivity
            local yAngle = -delta.Y * sensitivity
            local currentCFrame = cam.CFrame
            local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, xAngle, 0) * currentCFrame * CFrame.Angles(yAngle, 0, 0)
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentCFrame.Position, currentCFrame.Position + newCFrame.LookVector)
        end
    end
end)

camZone.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        draggingCam = false
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D-PAD DE MOVIMIENTO (WASD)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local keysPressed = { W = false, A = false, S = false, D = false }
local keyMap = { W = Enum.KeyCode.W, A = Enum.KeyCode.A, S = Enum.KeyCode.S, D = Enum.KeyCode.D }

local dpadFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
dpadFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 160)
dpadFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 0.55, 0)
dpadFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dpadFrame.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local btnW = makeButton("Key_W", "W", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 0), dpadFrame)
local btnA = makeButton("Key_A", "A", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 52), dpadFrame)
local btnS = makeButton("Key_S", "S", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 104), dpadFrame)
local btnD = makeButton("Key_D", "D", UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48), UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 52), dpadFrame)

local function setupKeyEvents(btn, keyName)
    local keyCode = keyMap[keyName]
    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            keysPressed[keyName] = true
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.0
            if VirtualInputManager and keyCode then VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game) end
        end
    end)
    btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            keysPressed[keyName] = false
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
            if VirtualInputManager and keyCode then VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game) end
        end
    end)
end

setupKeyEvents(btnW, "W")
setupKeyEvents(btnA, "A")
setupKeyEvents(btnS, "S")
setupKeyEvents(btnD, "D")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if not hum or not hum.Parent or not hum.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    if keysPressed.W then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    if keysPressed.S then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
    if keysPressed.A then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
    if keysPressed.D then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
    
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera and moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local forward = Vector3.new(camCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camCFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
        local right = Vector3.new(camCFrame.RightVector.X, 0, camCFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
        local worldDirection = (forward * -moveVector.Z) + (right * moveVector.X)
        hum:Move(worldDirection, false)
    else
        hum:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TECLADO VIRTUAL DE CHAT FLOTANTE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local chatKeyboardFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
chatKeyboardFrame.Name = "CustomChatKeyboard"
chatKeyboardFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.42, 0)
chatKeyboardFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.55, 0)
chatKeyboardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
chatKeyboardFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
chatKeyboardFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local kbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
kbCorner.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

local inputDisplay = Instance.new("TextLabel")
inputDisplay.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.18, 0)
inputDisplay.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.04, 0)
inputDisplay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
inputDisplay.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
inputDisplay.TextSize = 14
inputDisplay.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
inputDisplay.Text = ""
inputDisplay.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
inputDisplay.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

local closeKbBtn = makeButton("CloseKB", "❌", UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.18, 0), UDim2.new(0.83, 0, 0.04, 0), chatKeyboardFrame, Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40))

local keysLayout = {
    {"Q","W","E","R","T","Y","U","I","O","P"},
    {"A","S","D","F","G","H","J","K","L"},
    {"Z","X","C","V","B","N","M","←"}
}

local currentMessage = ""

local function updateChatDisplay()
    inputDisplay.Text = "  " .. currentMessage .. "_"
end

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    if msg == "" or string.gsub(msg, " ", "") == "" then return end
    pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then generalChannel:SendAsync(msg) end
        else
            ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local keyContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
keyContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.96, 0, 0.72, 0)
keyContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.25, 0)
keyContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
keyContainer.Parent = chatKeyboardFrame

for rIndex, row in ipairs(keysLayout) do
    local rowFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    rowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.23, 0)
    rowFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (rIndex - 1) * 0.25, 0)
    rowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rowFrame.Parent = keyContainer

    local keyWidth = 1 / #row
    for kIndex, char in ipairs(row) do
        local btn = makeButton("K_"..char, char, UDim2.new(keyWidth - 0.01, 0, 0.9, 0), UDim2.new((kIndex - 1) * keyWidth, 0, 0, 0), rowFrame, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55))
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if char == "←" then
                currentMessage = string.sub(currentMessage, 1, #currentMessage - 1)
            else
                currentMessage = currentMessage .. string.lower(char)
            end
            updateChatDisplay()
        end)
    end
end

local spaceBtn = makeButton("K_Space", "ESPACIO", UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.2, 0), UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.78, 0), keyContainer, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65))
spaceBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    currentMessage = currentMessage .. " "
    updateChatDisplay()
end)

local sendBtn = makeButton("K_Send", "ENVIAR ↵", UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.2, 0), UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.78, 0), keyContainer, Color3.fromRGB(30, 120, 50))
sendBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sendChatMessage(currentMessage)
    currentMessage = ""
    updateChatDisplay()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
end)

closeKbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BARRA SUPERIOR (1-9, CHAT, ESC, INVENTARIO)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local topBarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
topBarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 35)
topBarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.01, 0)
topBarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topBarFrame.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local keyCodesNum = {
    Enum.KeyCode.One, Enum.KeyCode.Two, Enum.KeyCode.Three,
    Enum.KeyCode.Four, Enum.KeyCode.Five, Enum.KeyCode.Six,
    Enum.KeyCode.Seven, Enum.KeyCode.Eight, Enum.KeyCode.Nine
}

for i = 1, 9 do
    local btnNum = makeButton("Key_"..i, tostring(i), UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * 30, 0, 0), topBarFrame)
    btnNum.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        simulateKey(keyCodesNum[i])
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = getHumanoid()
        if not char or not hum then return end
        
        local tools = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, item) end end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(tools, item) end end
        
        local targetTool = tools[i]
        if targetTool then
            local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if currentTool == targetTool then
                hum:UnequipTools()
            else
                hum:EquipTool(targetTool)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local btnChat = makeButton("Btn_Chat", "💬", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 275, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 100))
btnChat.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    chatKeyboardFrame.Visible = not chatKeyboardFrame.Visible
    if chatKeyboardFrame.Visible then
        currentMessage = ""
        updateChatDisplay()
    end
end)

local btnEsc = makeButton("Btn_Esc", "⚙️", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 315, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80))
btnEsc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.Escape)
end)

local btnInv = makeButton("Btn_Inv", "🎒", UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0, 355, 0, 0), topBarFrame, Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 40))
btnInv.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.Backquote)
    pcall(function()
        local backpackEnabled = StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack)
        StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, not backpackEnabled)
    end)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BOTONES DE ACCIÓN (CLICS, R, Q, TAB, SALTAR, CORRER, CTRL)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local actionFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
actionFrame.Name = "ActionFrame"
actionFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 180)
actionFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0.58, 0)
actionFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
actionFrame.Parent = mainControlsFrame

local btnLClick = makeButton("Btn_LClick", "CLIC IZQ", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 20))
btnLClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if VirtualInputManager then
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
        task.delay(0.05, function() VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0) end)
    end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then tool:Activate() end
    end
end)

local btnRClick = makeButton("Btn_RClick", "CLIC DER", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 0), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(80, 20, 20))
btnRClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if VirtualInputManager then
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, true, game, 0)
        task.delay(0.05, function() VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, false, game, 0) end)
    end
end)

local btnE = makeButton("Btn_E", "E", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 0), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 90))
btnE.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.E)
end)

local btnR = makeButton("Btn_R", "R", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 42), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(70, 50, 20))
btnR.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.R)
end)

local btnQ = makeButton("Btn_Q", "Q", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 42), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(20, 60, 70))
btnQ.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.Q)
end)

local btnTab = makeButton("Btn_Tab", "TAB", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 42), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(50, 30, 70))
btnTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.Tab)
end)

local btnSpace = makeButton("Btn_Space", "SALTAR", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50))
btnSpace.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.Jump = true end
end)

local isRunning = false
local btnShift = makeButton("Btn_Shift", "CORRER", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 84), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 20))
btnShift.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isRunning = not isRunning
    btnShift.BackgroundTransparency = isRunning and 0.0 or 0.25
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = isRunning and 24 or 16 end
end)

local btnCtrl = makeButton("Btn_Ctrl", "CTRL", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 84), actionFrame, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40))
btnCtrl.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    simulateKey(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
end)

scripts.script:
local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui", p.PlayerGui)
g.Name = "AnimToggle"
g.ResetOnSpawn = false

local main = Instance.new("Frame", g)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 70)
main.Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0.5, -35)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
Instance.new("UICorner", main)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
title.Text = "  Anim Controller"
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", title)

local btnMin = Instance.new("TextButton", title)
btnMin.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
btnMin.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 0)
btnMin.Text = "-"
btnMin.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70,70,70)
btnMin.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
btnMin.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btnMin.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", btnMin)

local b = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 25)
b.Text = "ANIM: OFF"
b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)
b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
b.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", b)

-- DRAG & MINIMIZE
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true dragStart = input.Position startPos = main.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function() if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
	end
end)
title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput = input end
end)
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

local minimized = false
btnMin.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	if minimized then main.Size = UDim2.new(0,140,0,20) b.Visible=false btnMin.Text="+" 
	else main.Size = UDim2.new(0,140,0,70) b.Visible=true btnMin.Text="-" end
end)

-- ANIM + FOOTSTEP
local IDLE = "rbxassetid://112916477760662"
local WALK = "rbxassetid://95388940645239"
local RUN = "rbxassetid://119327996325377"
local FOOTSTEP_ID = "rbxassetid://137620518840395"

local enabled = false
local curTrack, conn, stepConn
local tracks = {}
local stepSound = nil

local function stopAll()
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.15) curTrack=nil end
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn=nil end
	if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() stepConn=nil end
	for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0.15) end) end
	tracks = {}
	if stepSound then stepSound:Stop() end
end

local function createFootstepSound(root)
	if stepSound then stepSound:Destroy() end
	stepSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	stepSound.Name = "Footstep"
	stepSound.SoundId = FOOTSTEP_ID
	stepSound.Volume = 1
	stepSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	stepSound.Parent = root
end

local function loadAll(hum)
	stopAll()
	local char = hum.Parent
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
	
	createFootstepSound(root)
	
	local function make(id)
		local a = Instance.new("Animation") a.AnimationId = id
		return animator:LoadAnimation(a)
	end
	tracks.Idle = make(IDLE) tracks.Walk = make(WALK) tracks.Run = make(RUN)
	for _, t in pairs(tracks) do t.Looped = true t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement end
end

local function play(name)
	if not enabled then return end
	if not tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack == tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.15) end
	curTrack = tracks[name] curTrack:Play(0.15)
end

local function hookHumanoid(hum)
	loadAll(hum)
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
	if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() end
	
	local lastStep = 0
	conn = hum.Running:Connect(function(s)
		if not enabled then return end
		if s < 0.1 then 
			play("Idle")
		elseif s < 16 then 
			play("Walk") 
		else 
			play("Run") 
		end
	end)
	
	-- FOOTSTEP LOOP
	stepConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not enabled or not stepSound then return end
		if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			local speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude * hum.WalkSpeed
			local interval = speed > 16 and 0.25 or 0.4 -- lari lebih cepet bunyinya
			if tick() - lastStep >= interval then
				lastStep = tick()
				stepSound:Play()
			end
		end
	end)
	
	play("Idle")
end

b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		b.Text = "ANIM: ON" b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0)
		local char = p.Character or p.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		hookHumanoid(char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"))
	else
		b.Text = "ANIM: OFF" b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)
		stopAll()
	end
end)

p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if enabled then hookHumanoid(hum) end
end)

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Legends Battlegrounds uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, organizing combat, farming, visuals, movement, defense, misc, and settings into separate tabs. Combat tools cover hit-list injection, auto M1 with click, hold, or direct modes, click-rate and cooldown controls, whiff-punish removal, forced downslam, targeting filters, FOV circle display, lock-on hijacking, and a real hitbox preview. The auto kill farm parks behind a chosen target, leads moving opponents, locks onto one player by name through deaths and respawns, pauses between kills, gates swings intelligently, and optionally uses skill slots and awakening. Additional farm options handle destroyables and reward claims, while visuals provide player ESP with boxes, names, distance, health, state tags, chams, and tracers. Performance tools include a one-press FPS boost, a destructive potato mode, shadow and post-FX removal, texture stripping, terrain flattening, cloth-sim disabling, ragdoll-pool clearing, character-sound muting, quality selection, and an FPS cap. Movement features cover walk-speed and jump-height overrides, infinite jump, noclip, fly, infinite sprint, dash spam, and stepped teleports. Defense includes auto block, anti-fling, anti-ragdoll, stun stripping, anti-slow, anti-freeze, anti-void recovery, client-state clearing, and manual awakening. Misc and settings add anti-AFK, rejoin and server hop, local UI unlocks, remote spy logging, theme/config saving, and full cleanup on unload.

end)

    if not UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    end
end)

local function forcePC()
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
